units.source_text: 这是一个小阳春的天气。

en.t: It was a day of Indian summer weather.
Oshima could be faintly made out.

units.source_text: 不甚暖和的海面上，老鹰在翱翔。

en.t: Over the not very warm sea, hawks were soaring.

units.source_text: 庭院的草坪边缘，立着一排松树，给海镶上了一道绿边。

en.t: Along the edge of the garden lawn stood a row of pines, setting a green border around the sea.

units.source_text: 可以看见好几对新婚旅行的人，星星点点地分散在这草坪和海的连接线上。

en.t: Several honeymooning couples could be seen, scattered here and there along the line where the lawn met the sea.

units.source_text: 也许是置于宽阔明朗的景色之中的缘故，没有显出新婚旅行的不自然，倒显得温文典雅。

en.t: Perhaps because they were set within such broad, bright scenery, they did not show the awkwardness of honeymooners, but instead seemed gentle and elegant.

units.source_text: 新娘子的衣裳上现出海和松树的色彩，极目远望，

en.t: The brides' clothing showed the colors of the sea and the pines, and when one gazed far into the distance,

units.source_text: 呈现出一派朝气蓬勃的景象，使人更觉得幸福而新鲜。

en.t: it presented a scene full of fresh vitality, making one feel all the more happy and refreshed.

units.source_text: 到这里来的新婚夫妇，都是富家的新郎新娘。

en.t: The newlywed couples who came here were all brides and grooms from wealthy families.

units.source_text: 我带着近似悔恨的羡慕，对名人说：

en.t: With an envy that was almost regret, I said to the Master:
